scientific_limitations: Uniform scaling applies to bounded nonnegative scaled separations only.
Counts are in expectation; there is no probabilistic fluctuation theorem.
Only the coupled singular-scale profile and optimum are proposed as new, not the general exact covariance count formula.
Equivalent prior asymptotics under other terminology remain a historical-priority risk.
